definitions: A structure with a smooth, sloping surface for sliding down.
A small piece of photographic film in a frame for projection.
A part of a machine or instrument that slides.
A hair ornament that slides into the hair to hold it in place.
A geological movement of a mass of rock or earth down a slope.
examples: The children loved the slide in the park.
He showed us his holiday slides.
The slide on the microscope moved smoothly.
She wore a pretty slide in her hair.
The village was damaged by a mud slide.
